document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Neither of you cry out; perhaps you’re too astonished to do 
so.  A  short  distance  up  ahead,  a  band  of  bizarre  creatures 
toil, using machines held in delicate claws to suck up mineral 
deposits precipitated on the rocks. These entities resemble pink, 
five-foot-high crustaceans infested with fungoid growths. They 
surely could not have originated on this planet.

Gain 2 points of Cthulhu Mythos. To stand up and greet them in a 
friendly manner, go to 478. To try to sneak away unobserved, go to 
480. To open fire upon them, go to 479.
